_about: Content for the Pixie Dust Floral Design site. Each table mirrors a future Airtable base and uses the Airtable REST API shape ({ records: [{ id, createdTime, fields }] }). build/build.mjs reads this file at deploy time and pre-renders every page as static HTML, so search engines and AI crawlers see full content. To plug in Airtable later, build/build.mjs fetches the same tables from Airtable instead of this file (see 'AIRTABLE' there) and a Netlify build hook rebuilds the site when records change. This demo uses the local file only: no Airtable API key or live connection.

fields.Name: Kernersville
fields.Intro: Pixie Dust Floral Design is a Kernersville florist through and through. Tiffany designs every bouquet, centerpiece and arch in her home studio on Habersham Drive, so Kernersville couples get a designer who is minutes from downtown and from venues like the Paul J. Ciener Botanical Garden.
fields.Delivery Note: Kernersville is home base. Your florals are designed here, then delivered and set in place at your venue on the day.
fields.Popular Venues: Paul J. Ciener Botanical Garden | Garden ceremony sites and a ballroom on South Main Street in downtown Kernersville
fields.FAQ:
Q: Can I visit the studio in Kernersville?
A: The studio is at 6010 Habersham Dr, Kernersville, NC 27284. Studio hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 2pm and Saturday 10am to 12pm. Questions? Call (336) 310-9001.
Q: Do you deliver wedding flowers in Kernersville?
A: Yes. Kernersville is home base, and your florals are delivered and set in place at your venue on the day.

fields.Intro: Winston-Salem is about 12 miles west of the Kernersville studio, and it is where some of Tiffany's favorite weddings have happened, from a ceremony at The Barn at Reynolda Village to Melissa's simple, neutral florals for her September 2023 wedding.
fields.Delivery Note: Tiffany delivers to Winston-Salem venues. Melissa H. wrote that "delivery to our Winston Salem venue went smoothly."

fields.FAQ:

A: Yes. Tiffany's work includes a wedding at The Barn at Reynolda Village and Melissa H.'s September 2023 wedding at a Winston-Salem venue.

A: Yes. Winston-Salem is about 12 miles from the Kernersville studio, and wedding florals are delivered and set in place on the day.

fields.Question: Where is Pixie Dust Floral Design located?
fields.Answer: Pixie Dust Floral Design is Tiffany's home-based floral studio at 6010 Habersham Dr, Kernersville, NC 27284. Studio hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 2pm and Saturday 10am to 12pm.

fields.Question: What wedding flowers does Tiffany design?
fields.Answer: Bridal bouquets, bridesmaids' bouquets, boutonnieres and corsages, ceremony arches and altar arrangements, centerpieces, installations and full reception styling.

fields.Question: What flowers does Tiffany specialize in?
fields.Answer: Her favorites include ranunculus, coral charm peonies, astilbe and succulents, alongside garden roses and seasonal blooms chosen for your colors.

fields.Question: How do I check if my wedding date is available?
fields.Answer: Fill out the inquiry form with your date, venue, estimated guest count, floral budget and a little about your vision, or call (336) 310-9001. Tiffany reviews every inquiry and follows up to talk flowers and next steps.

fields.Question: Why does the inquiry form ask for my floral budget?
fields.Answer: Your budget range (under $1,000, $1,000 to $2,500, $2,500 to $5,000, or $5,000+) helps Tiffany recommend the designs that make the most of it before you ever get on the phone.

fields.Question: Do you deliver and set up at the venue?
fields.Answer: Yes. On the wedding day your florals arrive fresh and are set in place at your venue.

fields.Question: Where do you deliver?
fields.Answer: The studio is in Kernersville, and Tiffany delivers to Kernersville and Winston-Salem venues. Planning somewhere else in the Triad? Include your venue in your inquiry and she will confirm.

fields.Question: How much are the floral pumpkin centerpieces?
fields.Answer: Tiffany's signature flower-filled pumpkin centerpieces start at $65. They are available in the fall by pre-order only.

fields.Question: Do you make everyday and sympathy arrangements?
fields.Answer: Yes. Tiffany designs birthday, anniversary and get-well arrangements, corsages, and thoughtful sympathy pieces, all custom and made with the same care as a wedding.

fields.Question: Where can I see more of Tiffany's work?
fields.Answer: Browse the gallery on this site or follow @pixiedustflorals on Instagram for her latest designs.
